# TikTok Data Extractor

The Apify actor [`clockworks/free-tiktok-scraper`](https://apify.com/clockworks/free-tiktok-scraper) as typed Telo kinds, generated from its build **0.0.538**. The module's version is that build number, and every run it starts is pinned to exactly that build, so the input types below are the ones the actor really runs with.

Extract data about videos, users, and channels based on hashtags or scrape full user profiles including posts, total likes, name, nickname, numbers of comments, shares, followers, following, and more.

## Pricing

Pay per event — Result $0.003, Add-on: Date filter $0.0013, Add-on: Popularity filter $0.0013, Add-on: Follower / Following $0.004, Add-on: Search video sorting $0.0013, Add-on: Video download $0.0013, Add-on: Comment $0.00125, Add-on: Scrape as in country $0.0013, Add-on: Transcript $0.048 (Free-plan prices; paid plans pay less). Cap the spend with `maxTotalChargeUsd`.

Runs are charged to the Apify account whose token the `ApifyClient` holds. See the [Store page](https://apify.com/clockworks/free-tiktok-scraper) for current prices.

## Import

```yaml
imports:
  Actor: oci://ghcr.io/telorun/apify/clockworks-free-tiktok-scraper@0.0.538#sha256-…
```

Pin the digest with `telo upgrade`. The module re-exports `ApifyClient`, so it is the only import needed.

## Usage

```yaml
kind: Actor.ApifyClient
metadata: { name: apify }
token: !cel "secrets.apifyToken"
---
kind: Actor.Run          # or Actor.Start for runs longer than 5 minutes
metadata: { name: scrape }
client: !ref apify
maxTotalChargeUsd: 1     # optional: timeout, memory, maxItems, maxTotalChargeUsd
---
kind: Run.Sequence
metadata: { name: main }
steps:
  - name: scrape
    invoke: !ref scrape
    inputs: {}
```

- **`Run`** calls Apify's synchronous endpoint and returns `{ items }`. Apify holds the request open for at most 300 seconds; a longer run fails with HTTP 408.
- **`Start`** starts the run, long-polls it until it finishes, and returns `{ run, items }`. A run that ends `FAILED`, `TIMED-OUT` or `ABORTED` raises `APIFY_RUN_NOT_SUCCEEDED` with the run as `data`.

## Output

Each dataset item is typed from the actor's published dataset schema. Every field may be null, and items may carry fields beyond these.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | string \| null | Unique identifier of the TikTok video |
| `text` | string \| null | Caption text of the TikTok video |
| `textLanguage` | string \| null | Detected language of the video caption |
| `createTime` | number \| null | Unix timestamp when the video was created |
| `createTimeISO` | string \| null | ISO 8601 formatted creation date and time |
| `isMuted` | boolean \| null | Whether the video audio is muted |
| `webVideoUrl` | string \| null | URL to view the video on TikTok |
| `locationCreated` | string \| null | Country code where the video was created |
| `isAd` | boolean \| null | Whether the video is a sponsored advertisement |
| `authorMeta` | object \| null | Metadata about the video author |
| `musicMeta` | object \| null | Metadata about the background music used in the video |
| `videoMeta` | object \| null | Technical metadata about the video file |
| `locationMeta` | object \| null | Geographic location metadata if the video is geotagged |
| `mediaUrls` | array \| null | Array of media URLs associated with the video |
| `slideshowImageLinks` | array \| null | Image links for slideshow-style posts |
| `diggCount` | number \| null | Number of likes (hearts) the video has received |
| `shareCount` | number \| null | Number of times the video has been shared |
| `playCount` | number \| null | Number of times the video has been viewed |
| `commentCount` | number \| null | Number of comments on the video |
| `collectCount` | number \| null | Number of times the video has been saved/bookmarked |
| `repostCount` | number \| null | Number of times the video has been reposted |
| `mentions` | array \| null | Array of usernames mentioned in the video caption |
| `detailedMentions` | array \| null | Detailed information about users mentioned in the caption |
| `hashtags` | array \| null | Array of hashtags used in the video caption |
| `effectStickers` | array \| null | Visual effects and stickers applied to the video |
| `isSlideshow` | boolean \| null | Whether the post is a slideshow of images rather than a video |
| `isPinned` | boolean \| null | Whether the video is pinned to the author's profile |
| `isSponsored` | boolean \| null | Whether the video contains sponsored content |
| `hasTikTokShopProduct` | boolean \| null | Whether the video has a TikTok Shop product attached. Only meaningful when present: an omitted value means we could not determine it, not that the video has no product. Search results are the case where TikTok often does not expose the signal. |
| `commentsDatasetUrl` | string \| null | URL to the dataset containing comments for this video, if collected separately |
| `input` | string \| null | Original input value used to find this video |
| `url` | string \| null | URL associated with an error result |
| `error` | string \| null | Error message if the item could not be scraped |
| `errorCode` | string \| null | Machine-readable error code |
| `invalidUrls` | array \| null | List of invalid URLs that could not be processed |
| `submittedVideoUrl` | string \| null | Original video URL from the input, useful for mapping results back to inputs |
| `fromProfileSection` | string \| null | Profile section this video was scraped from |
| `isStory` | boolean \| null | Whether this item was scraped as a profile's active TikTok Story, rather than a regular post |
| `searchQuery` | string \| null | Search query used to find this video |
| `searchHashtag` | object \| null | Hashtag used to find this video |
| `searchMusic` | object \| null | Music used to find this video |
